integrity: The six-file report and included standard-library exact arithmetic verifier are complete and self-contained. No separate external certificate or independent review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact CDF is proved only on the upper area interval from sqrt(42+14 sqrt(5)) to sqrt(42+18 sqrt(5)) for an edge-two regular icosahedron.
Below the stated threshold, other sign-sum vertices contribute and this theorem does not provide the remaining density.
Historical priority is provisional, including a 2026 general polyhedral-brightness paper not fully accessible; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: An exact majority-mass upper brightness law for the regular icosahedron
